language.label: Language
language.description: The language of the overlay. System default follows your system language. Item names, stats and game terms stay in English, as in the game.

chatButton.label: Chat Button Overlay
chatButton.description: Show the floating chat button overlay in the bottom-right corner of the screen.

windowTransparency.label: Window transparency: <num>{{value}}%</num>
windowTransparency.description: See the game through window backgrounds. 0% is fully opaque.

enabled.label: Corrupted zone timer
enabled.description: Show which zones new Hell games corrupt and the time until the next rotation (every 15 minutes). Click it for the upcoming zones.

position.label: Timer position
position.description: Pin the timer to a corner of the game, or drag it anywhere on screen (switches to Custom).

zones.label: Timer shows
zones.description: Every zone, or only the zones you follow: the timer then counts down to the next one and lists only those (every zone while you follow none).

alerts.label: Zone notifications
alerts.description: Pop up a toast when the corrupted zone changes: for every new zone, or only the zones you follow. Toasts follow the Toast Popups switch in Chat settings.

followed.label: Followed zones
followed.description: The zones the timer and notifications follow when set to Only zones I follow.

enabled.label: Net worth ticker
enabled.description: Show your net worth, session change and HR per hour over the game. Click it for details.

position.label: Ticker position
position.description: Pin the ticker to a corner of the game, or drag it anywhere on screen (switches to Custom).

toastThreshold.description: While the ticker is on, show a toast when a snapshot changes your net worth by at least this much. Toggle the Net Worth toast type under <section>Chat settings</section>.
toastThreshold.label: Snapshot toast threshold (HR)

networth.hotkeyHint: The snapshot hotkey is configured under <section>Hotkeys</section>.

tracking.label: Save net worth history
tracking.description: Store snapshots of your net worth on pd2trader.com so you can see history and sessions. When off, values are still calculated but nothing is saved.

autoSnapshot.label: Automatic snapshots
autoSnapshot.description: Take a snapshot on this interval while Diablo II is focused.

description.signedOut: Sign in to your PD2 account to choose whether you appear on the leaderboards.
description.notLive: Leaderboards launch with Season 14. You can choose to make your profile public once they go live.
description.default: Show your net worth on the pd2trader.com leaderboards and a public profile page. Off by default: only you can see your history.

displayName.label: Shown as
displayName.description: Which of your game accounts names your profile.

showHoldings.label: Show holdings
showHoldings.description: Also list your top items and category split on your profile.

layout.title: Settings
layout.subtitle: Manage your settings and set preferences

validation.letterOrNumber: Must be a letter or number
validation.ctrlC: Ctrl + C is not allowed (reserved system shortcut).

warning.ctrlC: Ctrl + C is reserved for copying items. Pick another key.

hotkeys.hint: Leave the snapshot, market or builds key empty to turn that hotkey off.

priceCheck.label: Price check
priceCheck.description: Price check the item under your cursor.

listItem.label: List item
listItem.description: List the hovered item on the market.

chat.label: Chat Window
chat.description: Show or hide the chat window.

offers.label: Offers
offers.description: Open chat on the people you are selling to.

delist.label: Delist Item
delist.description: Delist the hovered item from the market.

snapshot.label: Net Worth Snapshot
snapshot.description: Take a net worth snapshot right away.

market.label: Market
market.description: Show or hide the market browser.

builds.label: Builds
builds.description: Show or hide the ladder builds.

directory.description: Path to your Diablo II installation directory. Leave empty to auto-detect.

detectFailed.title: Detection Failed
detectFailed.description: Could not auto-detect Diablo II directory. Please enter it manually.

directory.label: Diablo II Directory

season.label: Season
season.description: Filter price data by season. Past seasons require historical data to be available.

debugLogging.label: Debug Logging
debugLogging.description: Write console output to a log file for troubleshooting.

about.downloadFailed: Failed to download update. Please try again later.

auto.label: Automatic Updates
auto.description: Download and install new versions on startup, then restart. When off, you still get a notification when an update is available.

noAccounts.title: No accounts available
noAccounts.description: If you don't have the right account selected, you may receive 404 errors when listing items. Please authenticate to load your accounts.

token.description: Get your token from <site>projectdiablo2.com<icon></icon></site> after logging in. Check your browser's localStorage for 'pd2-token'.
token.label: PD2 Token

account.linked_one: {{count}} linked game account. Used for listings and offers.
account.linked_other: {{count}} linked game accounts. Used for listings and offers.
account.signInToLoad: Sign in to load the game accounts linked to your PD2 profile.
account.label: Account

fillStatValue.descriptionPercent: Percentage of the rolled value used as ± margin when filling stat ranges.
fillStatValue.descriptionFlat: Flat amount applied as ± margin when filling stat ranges (e.g. 2 → ±2).

marginUnit.label: Margin Unit
marginUnit.description: How the fill value above is interpreted. Flat is useful for low-roll stats like resists or +skills.

corruptedFilter.label: Default Corrupted Filter
corruptedFilter.description: Initial corruption filter applied when opening price-check on a corruptable item.

rankDisplay.label: Rare rank display
rankDisplay.description: How a rare's price rank among its slot is drawn in the price-check appraisal popover.

priceWindow.label: Price window
priceWindow.description: Recent sales the price-check average is based on. Thinly traded items fall back to a longer window, marked with a tag.

leaveMinEmpty.label: Leave Min Empty
leaveMinEmpty.description: When filling a stat range, leave the minimum blank so searches match anything up to the maximum.

leaveMaxEmpty.label: Leave Max Empty
leaveMaxEmpty.description: When filling a stat range, leave the maximum blank so searches match the rolled value or better.

chatTemplates.intro: Type <kbd>/</kbd> in a chat message to use these. Tokens fill in from the conversation; any other {{placeholder}} is asked for when you use the template. Star one to pin it as a chip above the chat message box.
chatTemplates.starredTitle: Starred: shown above the chat message box
chatTemplates.starTitle: Star: show it above the chat message box
chatTemplates.empty: No templates of your own yet.

timing.off: Notifications are off. Pick another option to edit the settings below.
timing.label: Notify when:
timing.description: Control when whisper notifications are played based on Diablo focus state.

ignore.label: Ignore List
ignore.description: Players in this list will not trigger whisper notifications.

notificationVolume.label: Notification Volume: <num>{{value}}%</num>
notificationVolume.description: Adjust the volume for whisper notification sounds (0-100%).

marketVolume.label: Market Alert Volume: <num>{{value}}%</num>
marketVolume.description: Volume of the market alert sound (0-100%).

marketSound.label: Market Alert Sound
marketSound.description: Play a sound with the popup for a new listing matching a market search you watch.

accept.intro: Customize the message copied when accepting an offer. Available placeholders:
accept.label: Accept Offer Message Template

reject.intro: Customize the message copied when rejecting an offer. Available placeholders:
reject.label: Reject Offer Message Template

sold.intro: Customize the message copied when marking an item as sold. Available placeholders:
sold.label: Sold Item Message Template

general.label: General Notifications
general.description: Play a notification sound when you receive non-trade whispers from players or new messages in the website chat.

toasts.label: Toast Popups
toasts.description: Show toast popup notifications when you are tabbed out of Diablo.

trade.label: Trade Notifications
trade.description: Play a notification sound when you receive trade whispers or trade offers from the website.

announcements.label: Announcement Notifications
announcements.description: Enable notifications for messages from *announcements. By default, announcements are ignored.

joins.label: Join Notifications
joins.description: Show a notification popup when a player joins the game (only when Diablo is not focused). By default, join notifications are disabled.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Color theme for every overlay window. Applies instantly.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Configure chat and whisper notifications, and your message templates.

about.title: About
about.description: Information about the application, its version, and the developer.

networth.title: Net Worth
networth.description: Track your net worth over time and show it in an overlay while you play.

stats.title: Price Check
stats.description: Configure the price window and how stat ranges and filters are populated for price-check searches.
